introduction.title: Makkah: the world's largest catering and hospitality market
introduction.lead: One business platform bringing food and beverage manufacturers and kitchen equipment suppliers together with Makkah hotels, catering companies and Hajj and Umrah missions.
paragraphs: Makkah welcomes millions of pilgrims and visitors throughout the year and hosts the largest concentration of hotels in the central zone, making it the most demanding market for catering services and high-efficiency kitchen equipment.

From this growing demand comes the Makkah Catering & Food Supply Exhibition 2027, bringing under one roof an integrated ecosystem of food and beverage manufacturers, catering and food supply companies, central kitchen equipment suppliers, refrigeration and packaging providers, alongside Makkah hotels, hospitality operators and Hajj and Umrah missions.

The exhibition is a genuine opportunity to build direct commercial partnerships, showcase the latest solutions that raise operational efficiency and guarantee food safety, and connect suppliers with the real decision-makers of Saudi Arabia's largest hospitality ecosystem.

importance.title: From the heart of the central zone, where catering decisions are made
importance.lead: Location is the greatest competitive advantage: the exhibition takes place inside the very ecosystem it serves, steps away from the Holy Mosque and Makkah's largest hotels.

cards.title: Heart of the central zone
cards.description: A strategic position within the hotels and operating facilities that run catering for pilgrims and visitors around the clock.

cards.title: A market that operates 365 days
cards.description: Continuous demand beyond a single season, from hotel kitchens and catering companies to food warehouses, outlets and services.

cards.title: Decision-makers in one place
cards.description: Procurement, operations and quality directors from hotels and catering companies, and Hajj mission representatives, on one sourcing platform.

importance.closingTitle: Why you need to be here
importance.closingText: Because participating in Makkah is not simply attending an exhibition; it is direct entry into a year-round catering market serving pilgrims from across the world.

timing.title: Timed ahead of the season, so contracts are signed on time
timing.lead: The exhibition takes place in January 2027, ahead of the main Hajj and Umrah season, giving buyers and suppliers enough time to complete contracts and mobilise.
